text:
ash: Hi all, following the python quickstart (docs link) and my first call returns 402 Payment Required. UI for the workspace shows a free trial badge though. anyone seen 402 for new orgs?

kevin: 402 usually means billing not set up for the workspace/org. Did you create the workspace via invite or self-signup?

ash: self-signup. I clicked the "Start trial" button during onboarding and it said trial activated.

olivia: Could you paste the exact request/response (redact keys)? Also which SDK version? We had a parity quirk where older python SDK maps 402 to a generic HTTPError with no body.

ash: request: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = c.generate("Hello")
print(resp)
```
response: HTTPError 402 with body: {"error":"billing_required","message":"workspace requires billing to be enabled"}

kevin: That body is explicit. The trial activation in the UI might have a downstream provisioning step that didn't finish. Usually a few minutes. Can you check Settings > Billing > Payment method?

ash: payment method none. I thought trial wouldn't need a card? The banner said "trial credit applied".

olivia: We recently changed trial semantics: new orgs in EU region require a verified payment method even for trial due to bank/regulatory constraints. Quickstarts don't call this out. Sorry about the confusion.

ash: ah that explains it. Is there a programmatic way to detect this so my app can surface a helpful message instead of failing?

kevin: The best approach for now: call /v1/org/status (internal endpoint) to get billing_required flag OR inspect error body for error=="billing_required" and message. We should standardize across SDKs to expose a typed BillingRequiredError.

olivia: Filed RED-5982 to add BillingRequiredError to python and node SDKs and update quickstart docs. devex-bot: Created RED-5982 and assigned to @olivia.

ash: For teams hitting this in CI, small tip: check env var REDWOOD_TRY_WITHOUT_BILLING=true during dev to skip the check (not for prod). Also adding a retry doesn't help here.

kevin: Also adding a short note to the quickstart: "If you see 402, check Billing page; some regions require a payment method to enable trial". I'll open a tiny docs PR.

ash: Thanks. One more oddity: the python sample app exits with stack trace instead of printing the json error body. Any guidance?

olivia: That's the parity bug I mentioned. Older python SDK raises requests.HTTPError that loses the response.json() content. Quick workaround: wrap call in try/except and print e.response.text. Example: 
```
try:
  resp = c.generate("hi")
except Exception as e:
  print(getattr(e, 'response', None) and e.response.text)
  raise
```
We'll land a SDK patch to raise our custom exceptions with .status_code and .json() by Friday.

ash: Great. Thanks for the fast triage. I'll update my team's onboarding doc with the payment note and the try/except until SDK fix lands.

devex-bot: Note: docs PR D-1025 created to update quickstart and sample-app, linked to RED-5982 and scheduled for next deploy window.
